intro.eyebrow: Atelier for houses at the edge of the sea
intro.lead: We design and build a handful of houses each year, on land most people would call too wild to build on.
intro.plotLine: Every house begins as a line drawn in the ground.

villas.name: Villa Kyma
villas.summary: Two limestone volumes laid low across the slope, so the bay is the first thing you see from every room.

villas.name: Villa Lefka
villas.summary: White plaster stacked into the cliff, with a narrow pool cut along the edge like a second horizon.

villas.name: Villa Pefko
villas.summary: Local stone and bronze among old Aleppo pines. Two reflecting pools carry the sea all the way to the front door.

villas.name: Villa Selene
villas.summary: A long, low house made for evenings. After dark the pool, the city lights and the living room become one room.

manifesto.label: Atelier
manifesto.before: A house on this coast should feel
manifesto.after: — as if the hill had been waiting for it all along.

columns.title: Site
columns.text: We walk the land at every hour before we draw a line. Wind, sun and the view decide where the rooms go.

columns.title: Light
columns.text: Openings are placed for the light at the times you actually live: coffee at seven, dinner at nine.

columns.title: Material
columns.text: Stone from the island, lime plaster, oak and bronze. Materials that age well in salt air and look better in ten years.

steps.title: Site study
steps.text: Topography, sun path, wind and views are mapped before a single sketch. We tell you honestly what the land allows.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Models, drawings and material samples on the table, room by room, until the house is unmistakably yours.

steps.title: Permits & build
steps.text: One team from permits to the last stone, with a fixed budget and a monthly visit report.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: Furnished, landscaped and lived-in tested. We return each season for the first two years.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Begin with a plot.
contact.text: Tell us where your land is, or what you are looking for. We take on a small number of new houses each year.

formFields.name: Your name
formFields.message: Where is your plot, or what are you looking for?

contact.formThanks: Thank you. We will reply within two working days.
